The clues are: Hina sits 1 seat(s) clockwise from Ishan; Juhi sits 2 seat(s) clockwise from Leela; Hina sits 3 seat(s) clockwise from Karan. How many seat-steps clockwise from Gaurav to Ishan?
questions.explanation: The clues uniquely give the clockwise order: Gaurav → Leela → Karan → Juhi → Ishan → Hina → back to Gaurav. In the marked seat order, Gaurav is at the apex, Leela at the upper-right side, and the queried placement/relation gives 4.
